dialogues.speaker: Anatole
dialogues.text: The experimental area is ready. Take these instruction manuals — Patrice was the one who wrote them down...

choices.text: Tell me more about the Fontaine Research Institute...

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: Well, the Academy is a research center founded by Alain Guillotin, and its full name is the "Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering." It and the Sumeru Akademiya are very different organizations.

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: We do not exercise any administrative responsibility over the people of Fontaine, as that would be redundant anyway, nor do we aim to educate. As the name may suggest, our focus is on research.

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: Let's just say that the Institute has greatly benefited Fontaine. Some of the clockwork mechanisms and kinetic cores created by Guillotin, who was regarded as a genius, are still being made by many factories today.

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: Haha, but all these things will eventually change, of course.

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: Well then. Can Patrice escape the pickle he is currently in? This experiment shall decide that.

choices.text: So, about the explosion you mentioned...

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: I wasn't in the country at the time, so I can't give you any first-hand information. It seems to have occurred when Senior Technician Edwin Eastinghouse was conducting an experiment using Arkhium that was aimed at dealing with the waterline crisis.

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: The explosion was very terrible indeed, and the incident really put the Institute on the map of Fontaine... To this day, they haven't found all the p... I mean, they haven't found Eastinghouse.

choices.text: Alright, let's begin in a bit.
